labels.opt_note: Not included in the total project value above. Quoted separately and may be commissioned at any time.

items.title: Design and build of the three-language mock-up (already done)
bullets: 72 pages in English, Vietnamese and Chinese; new design and motion
Kept from the current site: Koalendar booking on the page, the 7 articles, cloth information, contact
New: price list, the tailoring process, a shop with filters, WhatsApp/Zalo buttons, an enquiry form

items.title: Phan's real content
bullets: Replace the sample photos with real photos of the villa, the founders, garments and cloth
Add the missing prices, founding year, turnaround time and holiday closures

items.title: Showcase shop
bullets: Real products: Nobility cloth and ready-made pieces, with filters
Customers browse, then ask on WhatsApp/Zalo or book; no cart or online payment yet

items.title: Final translations
bullets: Review English, Vietnamese and Chinese; apply Phan's corrections

items.title: Google and moving from the current site
bullets: Old Google links forward to the new pages, so ranking is kept
Sitemap, Google Business (Maps) link, visitor tracking

items.title: AI fitting room integration (Anywear)
bullets: Attach the fitting room to product photos, pick the pieces that render well, test on phones
Privacy notice before a visitor turns on the camera

bullets.text: Anywear usage fees (if the paid plan is chosen) are paid by Phan's directly to Decart and are not in this quote. See the appendix.

items.title: Domain, hosting and launch
bullets: Set up hosting, point phanscustomtailor.com, https certificate
Email info@phantailor.com unchanged; the old site runs until switch-over

items.title: Testing and handover
bullets: Test on computers and phones, fix issues, walk-through for Phan's

notes: Timeline: about one working week from when we receive all photos and details.
Excludes: domain renewal (Phan's already pays this), AI fitting room usage fees, payment gateway fees.
Yearly hosting and maintenance: quoted separately.

items.title: Online sales and payment
bullets: VNPay or OnePay gateway (Phan's registers; transaction fees go to the gateway)

items.title: Web 3D showcase page
bullets: Give the Web 3D team's experience its own page on the site

appendix.title: Appendix: AI fitting room, free and paid
appendix.intro: The fitting room uses Decart's Anywear (an outside AI company). We integrate it and show you how it works; you decide whether to use it, and if you choose the paid plan you pay Decart directly. It can be switched off at any time.
rows: Quoted by Decart based on usage (no public price list)
Limited: Decart says the trial "won't serve your whole traffic". On the mock-up each visitor gets about 6 tries
Users have reported waiting in a queue
The try-on button only shows on pieces the AI renders well
Decart runs a quality pass on the whole catalogue
May end when Decart's beta ends
appendix.cost: Decart hasn't published a price for the store version. As a reference, its published developer rate is US$0.02 per second of try-on, about US$1.20 per minute. For example, 100 tries a month at 1 minute each is about US$120/month; 300 tries at 1.5 minutes is about US$540/month. These are estimates only; the real price comes from Decart, and we'll ask them based on Phan's visitor numbers.
notes: The fitting room shows style, colour and cloth on the visitor. Real measurements are still taken at the villa.
The visitor's camera feed is processed by Decart; the site shows a notice before the camera turns on.
You can start on the free version, see whether customers use it, then decide on the paid plan.
